seo.title: AI Discovery Workshop | SSW
seo.description: 3-day AI Discovery Workshop in Sydney, Brisbane, Melbourne & Newcastle. Identify custom AI opportunities for your business. Discover bespoke solutions tailored to you. Book now.

blocks.heading: Build a practical AI improvement roadmap in **three days**
blocks.description: Find where your teams can reduce administration, access information faster and improve everyday work. SSW works with your business and technology teams to assess the opportunities and develop a prioritised roadmap, with practical recommendations for your people, processes, systems and data.

blocks.heading: Trusted in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and Newcastle by
Start with your business, not the technology

features.heading: Find the problems worth solving
features.description: Your team knows where work gets held up: repetitive administration, information that is hard to find, slow approvals and manual reporting. We work with the people closest to these tasks to understand the problems, their impact and what a useful improvement would look like.

features.heading: Choose the simplest effective solution
features.description: The right answer may be a process change, better use of software you already own, automation or AI. We assess the options against business value, delivery effort, security and ongoing cost before recommending what to pursue.

features.heading: Day 1: Understand the business
features.description: Meet the people closest to the work, review representative tasks and documents, and identify bottlenecks. Understand your existing systems, data, licences and current AI usage.

features.heading: Day 2: Assess the opportunities
features.description: Evaluate where process improvements, existing software, automation or AI could help. Assess indicative benefits, effort, data readiness, security and licensing requirements. Shortlist suitable pilot opportunities.

features.heading: Day 3: Prioritise and agree next steps
features.description: Present a prioritised roadmap, recommended pilots and practical adoption priorities. Discuss proposed owners, success measures and next steps with your decision-makers.

blocks.heading: What You’ll Walk Away With
blocks.body:
You’ll receive a practical assessment and prioritised plan to help you decide what to pursue, what to defer and what needs further investigation. Your proposal defines the business areas covered and the depth of each deliverable.

Discovery provides the assessment and plan. Pilot delivery, implementation and ongoing support are scoped separately unless explicitly included in your proposal.

cards.heading: Current-state assessment
cards.description: A summary of how work runs across the agreed business areas, including the main bottlenecks, existing capabilities and constraints. We consider people, processes, systems and data together.

cards.heading: Opportunity register
cards.description: A structured list of improvement opportunities with indicative benefits, effort, dependencies and assumptions. We distinguish time released for other work from actual cost reductions and identify where estimates need further validation.

cards.heading: Roadmap and pilot recommendations
cards.description: Recommended priorities covering quick wins, medium-term initiatives and longer-term improvements. For shortlisted pilots, we outline the intended users, proposed owner, scope, dependencies and measures of success.

blocks.heading: At a Glance
blocks.description: A three-day, on-site discovery workshop focused on agreed business priorities. We assess where process improvements, automation and AI could deliver value, then recommend practical next steps.

features.heading: $12,000 + GST
features.description: Includes two senior consultants on-site for three full days. We agree the focus areas, required preparation and deliverables with you before the workshop.

features.heading: Grounded in your business
features.description: We examine real workflows with the people doing the work, using representative tasks and documents to identify useful improvements.

features.heading: Clear priorities and next steps
features.description: Recommendations ranked by expected value, effort, risk and readiness, with assumptions and dependencies made clear.

features.heading: Make more of your existing investment
features.description: We assess the software, licences and infrastructure you already have and identify where additional tools or expenditure may be needed.

accordionItems.label: Is this a consulting engagement or an AI training workshop?
accordionItems.content: This is a consulting engagement focused on your business processes, opportunities and priorities. We assess where improvements could deliver value and recommend practical next steps. We may identify training needs or illustrate an opportunity with an example, but a full training programme is separately scoped.

accordionItems.label: Who should take part?
accordionItems.content: We recommend a business sponsor, representatives who understand the selected workflows, and your IT team or provider. Include people who use AI regularly and people who have not yet found it useful. We agree the participants and time required before the engagement.

accordionItems.label: What preparation is needed?
accordionItems.content: You do not need prior AI expertise. We will ask for an overview of your priorities, systems and licences, along with representative documents and any relevant usage information. We agree how information will be shared and which stakeholders need to attend.

accordionItems.label: What will we receive?
accordionItems.content: Your proposal defines the deliverables and their depth. These typically include a current-state assessment, an opportunity register, a prioritised roadmap, pilot recommendations and adoption priorities. We present the findings to your stakeholders so you can decide what to do next.

accordionItems.label: What happens after discovery?
accordionItems.content: You decide which recommendations to pursue and who will deliver them. SSW can separately scope pilot delivery, implementation, training or ongoing support. There is no obligation to engage SSW for the next phase.

accordionItems.label: Can we use our existing software and licences?
accordionItems.content: We assess existing capabilities first. For recommended pilots, we check the relevant licensing assumptions and identify any additional usage charges, infrastructure or support costs. Owning an AI or automation product does not necessarily cover every proposed use.

accordionItems.label: How do you address security and reliability?
accordionItems.content: We work with your IT team or provider to assess relevant data access, permissions and security requirements. Pilot recommendations identify what the solution may do, where human approval is required and how its outputs should be evaluated. A detailed security audit is separately scoped where needed.

blocks.heading: Ulysses Maclaren
blocks.description: Uly brings 20+ years of enterprise consulting experience, helping companies adopt emerging technology with confidence. He’s led AI enablement sessions for businesses looking to cut through the hype and build systems that drive measurable outcomes.

blocks.heading: Built on Real-World AI Delivery
blocks.body: Our discovery work connects business priorities with the practical requirements of delivery. We assess the data, integrations, access controls, operating costs and adoption needs that will influence whether a recommendation succeeds in everyday use.

cards.description: Ulysses shares best practices for responsible AI: transparency, critical thinking, privacy, and using AI to actually boost productivity and stay ahead in your career.

blocks.heading: Find the right next step for your business
blocks.description: Tell us where work gets held up and what you want to improve. We’ll help define the right discovery scope.
